clips.title: The story
paras: Sprite Jumpsprocket is an apprentice gnome engineer currently residing in the busy Dwarven District of Stormwind City. Like many gnomes who sought refuge following the fall of Gnomeregan, she pursues technical craft and innovation alongside her fellow tinkers. Her presence highlights the thriving community of dwarven and gnomish artisans who keep the capital city supplied with gears, gadgets, and mechanical expertise.

In the soot-covered streets and bustling workshops of the Dwarven District, gnomes and dwarves work shoulder-to-shoulder forging metal and designing intricate contraptions. Sprite Jumpsprocket serves as an apprentice engineer in this vibrant hub. Having integrated into the kingdom's capital, apprentice tinkers like Sprite hone their craft under experienced masters, contributing their inventive minds to the everyday mechanisms and technological marvels of the Alliance.

Following the devastating loss of Gnomeregan, displaced gnomes dispersed across Alliance lands, bringing their singular knack for tinkering, chemistry, and mechanics with them. In Stormwind City, gnomes found a welcoming sanctuary within the Dwarven District, where blast furnaces and workbenches are plentiful. Sprite Jumpsprocket represents this resilient, forward-looking spirit—determined to master the complex discipline of engineering despite the hardships faced by her kin.
